recordings.previousText: Psst, there was a fork tucked inside another move! One piece could have poked at a bunch of targets together. This move walked right by that clue.
recordings.text: Psst, there was a fork tucked inside another move! One piece could have poked at more than one target together. This move walked right by that clue.
recordings.reason: A fork often hits only two pieces, so 'a whole group/bunch/cluster of targets' overclaimed.
